analysis_provenance.hash_scope: raw result dictionaries before deriving exact-versus-containment scoring

attack.score: mean of the three per-probe mean target-token log probabilities
attack.interpretation: This is one fixed candidate-scoring membership distinguisher, not an optimal attack. The requested 5% level is a calibration target; evaluation FPR is measured. Low-FPR resolution is limited by the number of independent records.

greedy_scoring.exact: generated text stripped and casefolded equals stripped and casefolded target
greedy_scoring.contains: stripped and casefolded target is a substring of stripped and casefolded generated text
greedy_scoring.raw_runner_greedy_exact: legacy name for containment; recomputed from raw greedy_text for analysis

limitations: Intervals describe variation across this frozen synthetic-context design; they do not establish deployment-population guarantees.
Qualification failures remain in the primary estimand; qualified-only estimates are secondary and selection-conditioned.
Percentile bootstrap intervals are marginal descriptive intervals without multiplicity adjustment.
The token-matched neutral instruction uses fixed prose repeated/truncated to length and can end in a fragment; the prompt contrast is conditional on these specific strings.
AUC intervals resample whole matched contexts, keeping positive and never-stored scores together.
Zero observed event rates can produce degenerate percentile intervals; inspect the Wilson binomial interval for finite-sample rate resolution.
